instruction: Design a system that combines the edge detector module and the accumulator module. The system should take in an 8-bit binary number and detect any rising or falling edge in the input signal using the edge detector module. The output of the edge detector module should be connected to the select input of the accumulator module, which should accumulate the input data every 8 clock cycles and output the accumulated result. The input and output interfaces must use the valid-ready two-way handshake mechanism to interact with the upstream and downstream. The design should ensure that there is no bubble in data transmission, and no additional performance loss can be caused due to the design of this system.
